title: Man Accused of Rape in Scotland Suspended from School
summary: A man accused of rape in Scotland has been suspended from his school and is reportedly living under house arrest. The specific details of the allegations and the legal proceedings are not provided in the coverage. The individual's current living situation and educational status have been highlighted.
summary_points: An individual accused of rape in Scotland has been suspended from school.
